en.headline: Hong Kong Legal Week 2026 opens Monday with Unidroit Asia-Pacific office launch
en.dek: The Department of Justice’s five-day flagship event begins on 2 November with the opening of Unidroit’s first office outside Rome.
body: Hong Kong Legal Week 2026, the annual flagship event of the legal sector and the Department of Justice, begins on Monday with the theme “Collaboration & Innovation: Legal Synergy for a Shared Future”.

The week opens with the Unidroit Centenary: Regional Conference for the Asia-Pacific and Opening Ceremony of the Asia-Pacific Liaison Office. The office, co-organised by the International Institute for the Unification of Private Law and the Department of Justice, is Unidroit’s first outside its Rome headquarters in its 100-year history.

Subsequent sessions include the third Asia-Pacific Private International Law Summit on Tuesday, a UNCITRAL 60th anniversary event on Wednesday, a Legal Tech Forum and the fourth Integration and Development Rule of Law Forum on Thursday, and the second Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area Lawyers Forum on Friday. Live broadcasts will be available on the dedicated Legal Week website and the government webcast platform.

zh.headline: 香港法律周2026星期一展開 揭幕國際統一私法協會亞太辦公室
zh.dek: 律政司旗艦活動由11月2日起一連五日舉行，首日舉行私法協會亞太聯絡辦公室開幕典禮。
body: 法律界年度盛事、律政司旗艦活動香港法律周2026，以「協作與創新：法律聯動 共建未來」為主題，將於星期一展開。
活動由國際統一私法協會百年慶典：亞太聯絡辦公室開幕典禮暨亞太區域會議揭開序幕。該辦公室由私法協會與律政司合辦，是協會成立百年以來首次在羅馬總部以外設立的辦事處。
其後包括星期二的第三屆亞太國際私法峰會、星期三的聯合國國際貿易法委員會成立六十周年誌慶活動、星期四的法律科技論壇及第四屆融通與發展法治論壇，以及星期五的第二屆粵港澳大灣區律師論壇。市民可於法律周專屬網站或政府網播平台觀看直播。
